confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from crowdsourced or aggregator price pages (MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, CostLiving, a Brno nightlife guide) and some are undated or from 2025, so they are moderate-quality. The midrange three-course meal and wine glass have no direct Brno price found and are model estimates. The cocktail is a bounded estimate from the local beer relationship plus one 2025 venue listing. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Brno and the Czech market, not from inspected or current listings. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate table for 16 October 2026; the page itself was not opened and checked directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable needed for food and drink, which uses Brno-specific aggregator data cross-checked against Czech national and Prague beer averages. Wine is inferred from the local beer ratio. Accommodation is a general estimate for a mid-sized Czech city priced below Prague.
